Edge perturbation is a basic method to modify graph structures. It can be categorized into two veins based on their effects on the performance of graph neural networks (GNNs), i.e., graph data augmentation and attack. Surprisingly, both veins of edge perturbation methods employ the same operations, yet yield opposite effects on GNNs’ accuracy. A distinct boundary between these methods in using edge perturbation has never been clearly defined. results.content: What is perturbation in machine learning? Perturbation in machine learning refers to a deliberate, typically small, change applied to data, model inputs, model parameters, or training dynamics to study effects on model behavior, robustness, generalization, or to produce desired outcomes (e.g., adversarial examples or data augmentation).
